objective: Scale Journey visuals to 1000+ Journeys without per-Journey workflow design.
normalCoverStrategy: one generated 16:9 master per Journey; responsive WebPs are deterministic derivatives

batch.carryoverPolicy: shared house style only; subject, geography, transport and composition must reset for every Journey
batch.reviewMode: review whole batch once; regenerate only outliers
batch.releaseMode: approved masters -> deterministic responsive derivatives -> registry/hero IDs -> validation

road-cinematic.scene: a single scenic road-travel scene with locally credible terrain and no invented route alignment
compositions: journey element small in a large landscape

rail-cinematic.scene: a single unbranded rail-travel scene with geographically credible surroundings
compositions: train small in a large landscape

nature-atmospheric.scene: a single atmospheric natural landscape grounded in the listed destination

coastal-editorial.scene: a single coherent coastal travel scene; no collage of ports or islands

culture-editorial.scene: a single street-level cultural travel scene; no collage of landmarks

planetary.scene: a premium full-bleed Natural Earth world map with the verified 195-country route rendered directly from platform geometry

qa: journey mode/character readable at thumbnail size
no invented map or route overlay
not visually repetitive with adjacent batch items
